create_workers: create worker threads bound to a list of torch devices and return their input and output queues
spawn_workers: spawn worker threads as a context manager for automatic cleanup of pipeline parallelism workers
test_Task_compute: test the Task class compute method to execute a micro-batch callback on a specific CUDA stream
test_Task_finalize: test the Task class finalize method to run post-compute logic on a batch with correct grad state
run_worker: run the worker thread main loop that pulls tasks from an input queue and pushes results to an output queue
